visual_name: Day in the life, part forty one: Brenda (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js ice rink at night (cut away at the front: ice with red and blue lines and a centre circle, white boards with a blue rail, dark stands with seats, overhead lamps, a players' bench), a cardboard cutout rival called Brenda on a stand (drawn on a canvas: sunglasses, pink top, thumbs up), a taped #1 sign, box-built skater with a black ponytail, a red puffer vest over a white turtleneck, black leggings, white skates with blades, phone sheets for her notebook page about Brenda (posts at 5 a.m., never misses, viral in Portugal) / the YourBrand campaign leaderboard (Ranked by counted views, Rank Creator Views Posts, her row with YOU at number four), hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 41.3 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: on an empty ice rink at night she posts alone, no team, nobody to beat, so she invented a rival, Brenda: posts at 5 a.m., never misses, went viral in Portugal. Brenda is a cardboard cutout she made, and Brenda still wins the race. Then YourBrand: the campaign has a leaderboard, real creators ranked by counted views, her row highlighted, fourth; number three is a real person; she posted twice this week. Brenda is still on the ice with a #1 sign. She thinks she is first.
